title: eriosyce crispa subsp. totoralensis
intro: Eriosyce crispa subsp. totoralensis, commonly known as Totora, is a species of cactus native to the coastal areas of Peru. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used by local communities for centuries. The health benefits of Eriosyce crispa subsp. totoralensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.
